explanation: p(1 - p) = 0.10 × 0.90 = 0.09, and 0.09 / 40,000 = 0.00000225, whose square root is 0.0015. Times 4 that gives an absolute MDE of 0.006, or 0.60 percentage points. Relative to the 10% baseline that is 0.006 / 0.10 = 0.06, so 6.0%. Typing 0.6 would give the absolute MDE in points, not the relative one.
